Exquisite Michelin Vietnamese dining experience 🇻🇳
Sep 2026 • Friends
Because of the room I stayed in at Sofitel Saigon Plaza, I enjoyed this exquisite Vietnamese Michelin-starred restaurant based on the recommendation of the customer service staff. The service experience was great; at least I didn't have to go out in the rain to find a restaurant. The fish seasoning was excellent 😎, even better than the sturgeon grilled sauce in Singapore's chicken porridge, and it had meat too. However, for the main course, the lobster 🦞 felt like it shouldn't have been fried first. After being drizzled with sauce, it was too wet and mushy, which ruined the original flavor of the lobster 🦞—what a pity.
Crab fried rice and lamb stir-fried rice noodles with plenty of steam, super satisfying! Highly recommend clicking.
Does the Dreamer cocktail I ordered 🍹 have plum wine as the base spirit? Japanese style is pretty good 👍
The dessert part, the ice cream 🍦 is delicious, the fried banana is just average haha 😁 Maybe it's due to my personal dietary habits.
